prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. Two sisters aged 68 and 76 sit close together on a garden bench, one gently placing a hand on the other shoulder as they exchange a knowing smile. Their everyday linen clothes are cream and muted olive. Use a considered paired portrait, soft open shade, a quiet garden backdrop, and clearly distinct faces with visible age lines. Output a square 1:1 composition for a website gallery. Make the key expressions and interaction readable at thumbnail size, with breathing room around the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearances: the 68-year-old sister has a short salt-and-pepper pixie, an angular face and a lean frame; the 76-year-old sister has longer silver hair loosely tied back, round cheeks and a fuller figure. Both have dark expressive eyes and real age lines.
Composition priority: exact 1:1 aspect ratio, one complete standalone photograph with comfortable safe margins.
review: Reviewed full square image: two distinct older sisters sit on a garden bench, one with short salt-and-pepper hair and one with loosely tied silver hair. The left sister's hand rests naturally on the other's shoulder; the right sister's folded arms and visible hand look plausible. Expressions and age lines are coherent. Square 1254x1254.
